# `MoveByAngle`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Mount move-by-angle progress and result.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | event (device sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER (observation only; receiving the event changes nothing) |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, guider NotifyState @0x6aea0, MoveByAngleFunc @0x6b080 (64-bit guider build), scope_move_left_by_angle handler @0x7d260; 32-bit counterparts present |

Guider-specific S-like helper (not the imager's S family): it writes state and an optional numeric value and adds no error or code. Sent by the move-by-angle worker and by the direct shortcut in scope_move_left_by_angle (manual-complete branch). The moving update follows motion-worker progress checks; no fixed interval or rate cap is established. Emitted by the guider on TCP 4400 to every retained socket; the main imager process forwards the line unchanged onto TCP 4700 (the auxiliary imager process suppresses guider forwarding). The imager installs a local callback for this name. No Android event branch is established.

Side effects: None for the receiver; the device sends this without a request.

## Request params

None. Events are sent by the device without a request; the payload is below.

## Payload

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Event` | string | yes | - | Discriminator. Fixed value `"MoveByAngle"`. [READ] |
| `Timestamp` | string | yes | - | Decimal string <seconds>.<nine digits> from clock id 1 (monotonic, INFERRED); not a calendar time. [READ] |
| `state` | string | yes | - | Caller-supplied: start, moving, complete or fail. One of: `start`, `moving`, `complete`, `fail`. [READ] |
| `value` | number | if state is moving and the progress pointer is non-null | - | Motion progress from a non-null float pointer on the worker's moving update; a null pointer omits it. Degrees is inferred. [READ; unit INFERRED (degrees)] |

## Errors

None. Failures appear in the payload (`code`, `error`) when `state` is `fail`.

## Example

Event, moving - Progress update (READ shape; value invented):

```json
{"Event":"MoveByAngle","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"moving","value":12.5}
```

Event, complete - Move finished (READ shape):

```json
{"Event":"MoveByAngle","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"complete"}
```
